title: anthriscus vulgaris subsp. hispanica
intro: Anthriscus vulgaris subsp. hispanica, commonly known as wild celery or smallage, is a plant species within the carrot family, native to Europe and Western Asia. The health benefits of wild celery include its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. Therapeutically, wild celery has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including skin conditions, respiratory issues, and menstrual problems, due to its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and spasmolytic properties. The bioactive constituents of wild celery include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
